product.summary: SafePal mobile wallet application and hardware-wallet companion interface.
product.notes: SafePal's first-party 2019 history establishes an active SafePal App release lineage before the later software-wallet upgrade: a July 2019 DEX announcement refers to the SafePal App and an upcoming official App/firmware version, while a September 2019 progress update states that nine App versions had already been released. SafePal separately records May 2020 as the launch of the SafePal Software Wallet capability. WLR therefore records the App's initial launch as 2019 at year precision and treats the 2020 software-wallet milestone as a later capability expansion, not the App's initial release.

events.title: SafePal App added self-custody software-wallet capability
events.description: SafePal officially released SafePal Lite inside the SafePal App, allowing users to create or import self-custody software wallets in addition to using the App as a companion for SafePal hardware wallets.
events.notes: This event records the software-wallet capability release, not the initial SafePal App launch. First-party SafePal posts show that the App already existed in 2019.

events.title: SafePal App released in 2019
events.description: SafePal's first-party 2019 history establishes an active mobile-app release lineage, including an official App version announcement and a later statement that nine App versions had already been released.
events.notes: Year precision only. The July 2019 source concerns a DEX-capable official App version and already refers to the SafePal App; it is not treated as the exact initial App launch day. The May 2020 Software Wallet milestone is modeled as a later capability expansion rather than the initial App release.

evidence.title: SafePal Download Center
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirming the active SafePal App, SafePal Extension Wallet, and supported SafePal S1, S1 Pro, and X1 hardware-wallet lines.

evidence.title: SafePal Lite Software Wallet is now ALIVE
evidence.notes: Primary SafePal announcement for the 2020-05-11 release of decentralized software-wallet functionality inside the existing SafePal App. It explicitly distinguishes this from the earlier hardware-wallet companion App.

evidence.title: Pre-announcement: Trade on DEX, with SafePal
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal article referring to users trading through the SafePal App and announcing an official App/firmware version for July 2019. Used to establish the 2019 App release lineage, not as proof that the announced DEX version date was the initial App launch day.

evidence.title: SafePal Progress Update
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal progress report stating that nine App versions and three firmware updates had already been released. This directly establishes an active SafePal App release lineage in 2019 while leaving the exact first public store-release day unresolved.
